description: Bounded source quad-edge divide-and-conquer Delaunay triangulation with Voronoi-dual checksum.

pinned_source.license_note: The source refers to olden_v1.0/COPYRIGHT, absent from the pinned repository snapshot; no license is inferred. Ports are independently written from the documented structures and algorithm.

contract.point_order: Strictly ascending x order; for five points the deterministic tree has root point 2, left subtree rooted at 1 with left point 0, right child 3, and extra point 4.
contract.algorithm: Use the source quad-edge structures and predicates. Three points take the source triangle base case. Five points recursively build a left three-point triangulation and right two-point edge, then merge with the source divide-and-conquer lower tangent and incircle edge-removal loop.
contract.dual_projection: For each finite Delaunay triangle, add floor(1000*center_x+0.5)+2*floor(1000*center_y+0.5); then add 100 per triangle, 10 per finite Voronoi edge, one per boundary ray, and one per Delaunay edge.
contract.general_position: Reject collinear point triples and, for five points, cocircular point quadruples.

output.meaning: Fixed-point sum of finite Voronoi vertices and combinatorial dual counts.
